text:
Alex H: Paging integration to the SMS relay is acting weird — multiple pages are being delivered as a batch ~30-45s after alert and sometimes duplicated. incident-bot did not escalate for a couple alerts. Anyone seeing this in logs?
incident-bot: I observed failed delivery retries -> queued. Last webhook responses: 202 accepted from relay-proxy, but no downstream ACKs. Marking alert thread as 'automation-fallback'.
Jada P: Confirmed. We're seeing the relay-proxy returning 202 quickly then buffering a handful of requests and doing a single downstream POST. That's why on-call saw one batched notification instead of per-alert pages.
Mike L: I just paged oncall (Maria) manually, she confirmed delay ~40s. Maria, did you get duplicates?
Maria G: Yep — got one immediate syslog and then a second SMS ~35s later. The incident thread never auto-created; I had to manually ack.
Sam K: Which deploy touched relay-proxy? I can roll back if it was the recent change.
deploy-bot: deploy/edge-relay-proxy v2.1.0 -> deployed by ci/cd at 1785554200 (sha: ab12c3). Feature: request-buffering for smaller upstream burst smoothing.
Jada P: That buffering mode is suspect. Logs show aggregated payloads with Content-Length that doesn't match concatenated body, relay tries to reserialize and we lose the X-Signature header on the second POST.
Alex H: Paste of the relay log snippet:
```
[1785554322] POST /v1/pager -> 202
[1785554322] buffered 5 requests, flush after 30ms
[1785554358] forwarded batch -> 202, missing header X-Signature on item#3
[1785554358] downstream ack timeout for item#3
```
Mike L: That header drop explains incident-bot rejecting the downstream webhook — signature mismatch. So relay buffering is corrupting headers in some cases.
Maria G: We had a customer-facing missed page for a monitoring alert (internal customer). They acknowledged late, no escalations triggered. Potential SLO impact: paging latency spike; need triage.
Sam K: Rolling edge-relay-proxy back to v2.0.7 now. Will patch deploy pipeline to pin buffering mode off.
deploy-bot: rollback edge-relay-proxy to v2.0.7 initiated by Sam K at 1785554360.
Jada P: After rollback, I see per-request POSTs again and no batching in the logs. Replaying the failed webhooks as manual sends now.
Alex H: Manual mitigation: replay queued webhooks individually to SMS relay for alerts that did not escalate. Ops: reach out to oncall owners confirming they performed manual triage.
Maria G: I opened a ticket with incident severity=low, customer impact noted: delayed pages to subset of customers, one duplicated page. No customer-facing outage, but SLA margin hit for paging latency.
Mike L: Action items: 1) revert buffering feature permanently until header-handling bug fixed 2) add automated test for header preservation under batching 3) postmortem and timeline. Assign to eng-sre and eng-infra.
Alex H: I'll file the postmortem and tag eng-sre. Thanks for quick rollback. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Postmortem template created: /incidents/1785554321/postmortem (assigned: Jada P, Sam K).
